title: R&M — Nelson City Council: additional real patrol zones found in the full 3,100-row raw log (Phase 2 import prep)
notes: Wave 1 seeded only 4 NCC zones (Marsden, Maitai Valley Rd, Atawhai, Trafalgar Park) from the List/reference sheet. Exporting the full 3,100-row DATA sheet and counting distinct Reserve codes found 22 real codes in use, most with real activity never captured. This wave adds the next 7 highest-value, confidently-geocoded ones (all verified live via linz-lookup address_autocomplete). Low-confidence/ambiguous codes (Smiths Reserve, Busch Reserve, Maungatapu Track, RICH, NELS) are deliberately left unplaced/unmapped — not guessed.

IMPORTANT: matches EXISTING org 'Nelson City Council' (organization_id 405fc1f7-45e8-4736-a517-885bb3e5ef95) via the seed script's parent_organization_id=R&M + lower(name) match — verified safe: two OTHER unrelated 'Nelson City Council' orgs exist in this project (a pre-existing E2E test fixture and a CRM-prospect lead, both under different parent providers), but the script's WHERE parent_organization_id = provider clause cannot match either of them. See docs/RM_ONBOARDING_TRACKER.md for the full finding.

No 'agreement' key included deliberately — NCC's operational agreement already exists and is accepted from wave 1; re-declaring it here would create a duplicate service_agreements row under this wave's own seed_key. New zones are linked to the existing agreement via a direct SQL INSERT INTO service_agreement_locations after this seed applies (same pattern used for DOC wave3b).
